jobs.title: Director, Cloud Governance
jobs.description:
Scopely
is seeking a Director, Cloud Governance
to lead efforts in establishing and enforcing standards, policies, and guardrails across Scopely’s multi-cloud environment. This is a remote opportunity for individuals in Canada or the United States.

As a Director, Cloud Governance
you will play a pivotal leadership role in defining and executing the Scopely’s Cloud Governance strategy. This team will define, implement, and enforce the policies and controls that govern how cloud infrastructure is used across a decentralized organization of game, platform, and product teams.

This role is critical to bringing structure, consistency, and guardrails to Scopely’s cloud footprint, and will be key in modernizing our overall governance posture. As a central leader, you will drive alignment across highly autonomous teams and translate governance into practical, adoptable solutions while balancing control and development velocity.

This is a foundational leadership role; you will establish governance from the ground up, introduce scalable and enforceable controls, and drive adoption and buy-in across various teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders.

What You Will Do

Build & Lead Cloud Governance

Build and lead a Cloud Governance team
Define the operating model for how governance partners with game teams, security, and FinOps
Establish clear ownership and enforcement mechanisms for cloud policies

Define & Enforce Cloud Guardrails

Design and implement enforceable controls across AWS and GCP, including:
AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies (SCPs)
GCP Organization Policies and IAM constraints

Establish guardrails around:
Resource provisioning and service usage
Region restrictions and data residency
Identity and access management
Network architecture and environment isolation

Own the mandate to enforce policies, including the ability to restrict or block non-compliant usage

Standardize Cloud Structure

Define and implement standards for:
AWS account structure and GCP project/folder hierarchy
Environment segmentation (prod, staging, dev)
Naming conventions and resource organization

Bring consistency across a fragmented, multi-team cloud footprint

Tagging & Governance

Define and enforce tagging standards in partnership with FinOps
Ensure all resources are attributable (ownership, environment, cost center)
Enable downstream cost allocation and operational visibility

Stakeholder Partnership

Collaborate with FinOps on cost allocation and optimization levers (budgets, quotas, usage controls)
Partner with Security to align governance with security and compliance requirements
Work directly with game teams to safely roll out and drive adoption of policies and standards

AI-Forward Governance & Automation

Define and execute an AI-native vision for cloud governance, transforming the function into an intelligent, policy-driven operating model powered by autonomous and agentic systems
Establish the organization’s strategy for governance autonomy, defining where fully autonomous operations, human-on-the-loop oversight, and human-in-the-loop approvals are appropriate based on risk, business impact, and compliance requirements
Architect and drive agentic governance capabilities that continuously monitor cloud environments, detect risk, and autonomously remediate anomalies at scale
Partner across engineering, data, and security, and platform teams to embed responsible AI governance into cloud platforms, establishing guardrails for AI adoption, autonomous decision-making, and auditability

What We're Looking For

10+ years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE
3–5+ years leading teams in complex, multi-team environments
Experience operating in decentralized or federated engineering organizations
Proven track record implementing cloud governance and enforcement at scale
Experience managing or influencing environments with $50M+ cloud spend
Deep hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
Experience with policy-as-code and governance tooling (e.g., OPA, Sentinel, AWS Config)
Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and multi-account design

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range

$175,000—$210,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Governance & Controls Engineering
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 261595

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Role

The Director, Cloud Governance & Controls Engineering is responsible for establishing, operationalizing, and continuously enhancing a fully automated control and governance framework for cloud platforms within a highly regulated global financial institution. This role provides enterprise leadership to ensure that cloud infrastructure and platform services are designed, built, and operated with appropriate risk management, regulatory compliance, and security controls embedded by default across the full technology lifecycle.

Reporting directly to the Senior Vice President & Global Head, Global Banking & Markets Engineering, the role blends governance accountability with a strong engineering mindset. The Director partners closely with independent risk, compliance, and control functions to define a comprehensive control inventory, while leading the automation and enforcement of those controls through scalable cloud engineering frameworks. This position plays a critical role in enabling safe cloud adoption at scale, supporting innovation while meeting regulatory and audit expectations.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of the cloud controls and governance framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory, risk, security, and audit requirements applicable to financial services.
Partner with independent risk, compliance, and control functions to establish and maintain a comprehensive, well‑defined control inventory for cloud infrastructure and platform services.
Lead the automation and enforcement of controls across the cloud lifecycle, embedding guardrails into engineering platforms, pipelines, and reference architectures.
Build and lead a high‑performing team of 3–4 specialists responsible for translating control requirements into scalable engineering solutions and reusable frameworks.
Collaborate with product and platform Technical Program Managers to ensure controls are captured early in design and consistently applied through build, deployment, and operations.
Define and oversee engineering‑led governance mechanisms, including dashboards, interfaces, and metrics that provide real‑time visibility into control effectiveness and compliance posture.
Influence cloud strategy and platform roadmaps to ensure risk and control considerations are addressed without compromising developer productivity or time to market.
Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and management reviews by providing clear evidence of automated control design and operation.
Establish standards, policies, and patterns that promote secure‑by‑design and compliant‑by‑default cloud engineering practices.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
Extensive experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, or cloud security within largescale, regulated environments.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automated controls, policy‑as‑code, and governance frameworks across IaaS and PaaS platforms.
Proven people‑leadership experience, including building and leading small, specialized technical teams.
Experience in financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.
Deep familiarity with public cloud platforms and modern control enforcement techniques (e.g., policy‑as‑code, CI/CD integration, cloud security posture management).
Experience engaging with regulators, auditors, and second‑line risk functions on technology control matters.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior technology and risk leaders.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days, and benefits will start on day one.
Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. jobs.title: Director, Developer Platform & Experience
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Motive is moving to an AI-driven development lifecycle. Agents that plan, generate, test, review, and help operate our systems — with engineers directing the work rather than typing all of it — are where software engineering at Motive is going. That direction is set. What we need now is a leader to build it.

We are hiring a Director of Developer Platform & Experience to own that execution and the platform underneath it. This role owns Motive's internal developer ecosystem end to end: developer experience, developer infrastructure, build and CI/CD systems, and the testing frameworks that let hundreds of engineers move quickly without breaking things. It also owns AI-DLC in practice — the tooling, cloud agent infrastructure, evaluation practice, and governance that determine whether agentic development actually makes us faster or just makes us noisier.

Our engineering organization spans North America, Europe, and Asia, across a Rails monolith, Go services, mobile, and embedded systems. How fast and how confidently that organization ships is one of our most important business levers.

This is a builder's leadership role, not a strategy role. You will inherit real systems and real teams, and be measured on whether engineers at Motive ship faster, with higher confidence, and with less friction than they did the quarter before.

The mandates

AI-driven development — make agentic development a governed, measured, everyday part of how Motive builds software.
Cloud-based agentic development infrastructure — build the substrate that lets agents run in the cloud, in parallel, safely.
Developer experience — make the inner loop fast and the right path the easy path.
Developer infrastructure — make build, CI/CD, and release systems fast, reliable, and cost-aware at scale.

The defining challenge: agentic development in the cloud

Most AI coding adoption stops at the laptop — one engineer, one agent, one local checkout. That ceiling is low, and moving past it is the signature technical challenge of this role.

You will build the infrastructure that runs agentic development in the cloud: ephemeral, reproducible, isolated environments where many agents work concurrently on real Motive codebases, run real tests against real dependencies, and open real pull requests — without an engineer babysitting a terminal, and without compromising security or blowing up spend.

This is a hard distributed-systems and platform problem, not a tooling procurement exercise. Done right, engineers stop being throughput-bound by their own machines and start operating as reviewers and directors of parallel work. We want a leader who finds that problem exciting and has the platform depth to solve it.

What you'll own

AI-driven development lifecycle (AI-DLC)

Translate Motive's AI-driven development direction into an executable multi-year plan — how agents plan, generate, test, review, and operate under human direction, what "human in the loop" means at each stage, and where engineers spend their time as a result.
Evaluate, select, and roll out AI developer tools (coding agents, code review, test generation, incident investigation, documentation) and build the internal scaffolding — context, MCP servers, evals, guardrails — that makes them effective on Motive's actual codebases rather than on a demo repo.
Stand up a rigorous LLM and agent evaluation practice: benchmarks, offline and online evals, quality and cost regression tracking, and a defensible model and vendor selection process that survives a fast-moving landscape.
Own the governance layer with Security, Legal, and Platform: acceptable use, code provenance and licensing, secrets and data handling, and audit trails for AI-generated changes.
Define and report the adoption and impact metrics that tell us whether this is actually working — not just seat counts and enthusiasm.
Bring the organization along. Drive enablement, internal advocacy, and the cultural shift from "write code, then review" to continuous review of agent-generated work.

Cloud-based agentic development infrastructure

Build and own the platform that runs agentic development in the cloud: on-demand, reproducible, isolated workspaces provisioned per task, with the right source, dependencies, secrets, and services already in place.
Design for concurrency and safety — sandboxed execution, least-privilege credentials, network egress controls, and blast-radius limits so many agents can run against real codebases without becoming a security or reliability incident.
Make agent runs fast and cheap: warm environment pools, caching and snapshotting, incremental builds, and test selection so a cloud agent loop is measured in minutes, not tens of minutes.
Own the orchestration and control plane — queueing, scheduling, autoscaling on Kubernetes, session lifecycle, artifact and log retention, and observability into what agents did and why.
Own unit economics. Instrument per-task and per-agent cost, set budgets and quotas, and keep the platform financially sustainable as usage scales across the org.
Build the human interface layer: how engineers dispatch work to cloud agents, monitor fleets of concurrent runs, review and merge results, and intervene when a run goes sideways.
Design for multi-region (US and EU) from the start, with configuration-driven rather than hardcoded regional behavior, and honor data residency and code-egress constraints.

Developer Experience

Own the inner loop end to end: local and cloud development environments, code search and navigation, IDE and agent tooling, dependency management, and onboarding time-to-first-PR.
Treat developers as your customers. Run regular DevEx research — surveys, interviews, instrumented telemetry — and publish a prioritized backlog the whole engineering org can see.
Define and drive the internal developer platform: golden paths, service scaffolding, and self-service capabilities that make the right way the easy way.

Developer infrastructure and engineering velocity

Own build systems, CI/CD, artifact and release pipelines, and the platform's outer loop across a Rails monolith, Go services, mobile, and embedded/firmware codebases.
Drive step-function improvements in DORA and velocity metrics: PR lead time, build and CI duration, CI reliability and flake rate, change failure rate, and time to restore.
Make cost, scale, and reliability of the developer platform a first-class concern — including multi-region (US and EU) behavior and configuration flexibility rather than hardcoded assumptions.

Testing and quality engineering

Own the testing strategy and frameworks: unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, hardware-in-the-loop, and performance. Drive test reliability, isolation, and speed so engineers trust the signal.
Build the infrastructure that makes high-quality testing cheap: fixtures, factories, test data management, environment provisioning, parallelization, and flake detection and quarantine.
Partner with quality and release engineering to shift quality left without slowing teams down.

Leadership

Lead a multi-team organization as a manager of managers, hiring and developing engineering managers and senior/staff-plus ICs.
Run an org distributed across North American and Asian time zones with genuine care for handoffs, overlap hours, on-call fairness, and inclusion — not just calendar math.
Operate as a peer to product and infrastructure leaders, influence a large engineering org without direct authority, and communicate strategy and results credibly to executives.

What we're looking for

Required

12+ years in software engineering with 6+ years leading engineering teams, including 2+ years as a manager of managers (Director, Senior Manager of Managers, or equivalent scope).
A real developer background — you have shipped and operated production systems, and engineers respect your technical judgment.
Deep DevOps and infrastructure depth: CI/CD, build systems, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform), cloud platforms (AWS preferred), and observability.
Demonstrated ownership of developer productivity, developer platform, or developer infrastructure at meaningful scale (hundreds of engineers or a large multi-language codebase), with measurable velocity outcomes you can describe.
Hands-on experience with modern AI developer tooling and a clear, opinionated point of view on where agentic development genuinely helps and where it does not.
Experience building or operating cloud-based development or execution environments — remote dev environments, ephemeral CI/build workers, container sandboxing, or multi-tenant compute platforms — including the security and cost controls that make them viable at scale.
Practical understanding of LLM evaluation — how to benchmark models and agents for coding tasks, how to measure quality and cost, and how to avoid being sold a demo.
Strong empathy for developers: you instrument the pain, listen to it, and prioritize accordingly rather than shipping platforms nobody adopts.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.

Preferred

Experience with a large monolith undergoing modernization, and with polyglot environments (Ruby on Rails, Go, mobile, embedded).
Background in test infrastructure at scale — flake reduction, test selection, parallelization, hermetic environments.
Experience running platform work as a product: roadmaps, adoption funnels, internal customers, feature-flagged rollouts.
Familiarity with multi-region deployment and data residency constraints (US/EU).
Open source contribution, developer community involvement, or public writing on developer productivity or AI-assisted engineering.

Pay Transparency

Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits .

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the compensation range is:

Canada

$238,000—$300,000 CAD

jobs.title: Director of Marketing & Digital Commerce
jobs.description:
About the job

Barbecues Galore is a specialty retailer with eight store locations and a growing e-commerce business. We help customers explore barbecues, outdoor kitchens, patio furniture, fireplaces, accessories and related products through knowledgeable in-store service and convenient online shopping.

We are looking for a Director of Marketing & Digital Commerce to lead our entire marketing and e-commerce operations. You will own the website and digital content, build our brand, bring more customers into our showrooms and grow profitable online revenue. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can turn strategy into measurable retail and digital sales results.

Key Areas of Responsibility

·  Retail traffic and sales: Create local and company-wide campaigns that increase qualified visits and sales at all eight stores; lead local SEO, Google Business Profiles, geo-targeted advertising, signage and store-specific promotions.
·  E-commerce growth: Own online sales strategy, revenue targets, merchandising, customer acquisition, conversion, checkout improvements, average order value, retention and profitability.
·  One connected customer journey: Make the website a powerful research and store-visit tool as well as a high-performing online shop; connect promotions, product information and customer experiences across channels.
·  Website and digital content: Direct website strategy, design, navigation, mobile experience, development roadmap and optimization; maintain accurate product descriptions, specifications, pricing, imagery, videos, buying guides and landing pages.
·  Marketing and brand: Lead brand positioning, seasonal campaigns, paid search and social, SEO, email, social content, creative production, product launches and customer loyalty initiatives.
·  In-store cooking demos and vendor events: Plan and schedule demonstrations across stores, delivered by our own teams and vendor representatives; coordinate products, staffing, logistics and promotion to generate attendance, engagement and sales.
·  Team and partner leadership: Lead and develop marketing and e-commerce employees; manage agencies, developers, vendors, projects and collaboration with store management, Purchasing, Operations and IT.
·  Budgets, systems and results: Manage marketing budgets and digital tools; coordinate with IT on e-commerce, CRM, inventory and POS integrations; track performance and improve marketing return on investment.

How success will be measured

Growth in store traffic and retail sales; profitable online revenue; website conversion and average order value; customer acquisition and retention; local search visibility; successful in-store events; campaign return on investment; and strong team execution.

Qualifications & Experience

Required
Significant leadership experience in marketing, digital commerce, and retail-related business operations.
Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies that drive both physical store traffic and online sales.
Strong understanding of omnichannel retail marketing and customer purchasing behavior.
Experience managing e-commerce platforms and delivering measurable online revenue growth.
Proven ability to lead marketing teams, manage budgets, and oversee external agencies.
Experience with website management, digital content, SEO, paid advertising, and analytics.
Strong knowledge of digital customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies.
Experience planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect marketing initiatives to revenue and profitability.
Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and project management skills.

Preferred
Experience in multi-location retail environments.
Experience in specialty retail, home improvement, outdoor living, appliances, or other product-focused retail categories.
Experience with large online product catalogues and complex product information.
Familiarity with retail point-of-sale, inventory, CRM, ERP, and e-commerce integrations.
Experience developing local store marketing programs alongside national or company-wide campaigns.
Experience managing seasonal retail promotional calendars.
Demonstrated success leading website improvements and digital transformation projects.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing leader who understands that the ultimate objective of marketing is to generate profitable business growth.

This individual understands the importance of physical retail stores and recognizes that a strong digital presence should not only generate online sales but also bring more customers into our showrooms.They will have the ability to develop a cohesive strategy across marketing, e-commerce, and retail operations while maintaining strong attention to execution, detail, and measurable performance.They will be comfortable leading a team, managing external partners, working closely with store management, overseeing website development, and making data-driven decisions.

Most importantly, they will take ownership of results and demonstrate the ability to translate marketing strategy into increased store traffic, stronger online sales, and sustainable company growth.

Interested? Apply with your résumé and examples of measurable retail and/or e-commerce growth you have led.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The ITFM (IT Financial Management) practice helps IT leaders around the world answer a hard question with evidence: how does our technology spend compared to our peers, and where should we improve? As Research Director, you own the delivery of Infotech's flagship IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking service - the engagements that put that evidence in front of CIOs and CFOs.

You will provide experience-based benchmarking insight and guidance that helps IT leaders drive measurable results, maintaining an active pulse on the needs of Members located globally and staying current on industry developments so you can deliver exceptional service across calls and benchmark engagements - in collaboration with analysts, Research Directors, and colleagues across the Research Division.

This is a senior, client-facing advisory role. While it is not a formal people-management position, you set the standard the wider ITFM analyst team works to, and your judgment shapes how the benchmarking service itself evolves.

Our promise to you

You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback, and building strong relationships.

What You Will Do, Includes, But Not Limited To

Lead ITFM Benchmarking engagements

Lead and deliver ITFM’s flagship offering - IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking engagements with analyst support.
Act as a trusted guide for C-suite clients in IT Financial Management, sharing insight on how to manage costs better and lessons from their industry on improving IT’s cost-to-value through benchmarking.
Improve the benchmarking service through your expertise — new ways of representing data and new opportunities to enhance the insights delivered.
Keep a pulse on industry trends and best practices in your areas of expertise, contributing ideas that shape the benchmarking service.

Cross Departmental Collaboration & Support

Support Call Advisory, Workshops, and Global Services teams by advising peers on IT Spend and Staff Benchmark research and analysis as needed.
Provide subject-matter expertise and feedback to other Research Division teams and to partnering divisions — Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, and others — as needed.
Design and build high-quality keynote and other presentations and deliver them successfully as needed.

Practice & Analyst Development

Contribute to and help with own benchmarking methodology, mapping standards, and delivery toolsets, working with Research Directors and the Practice Lead.
Support automation and data infrastructure initiatives that improve engagement consistency and scalability.
Mentor Research Analysts, reviewing their benchmark outputs and client-ready materials and helping them progress toward independent engagement leadership.
Make active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analysis, research, and writing workflows, and help bring effective practices to the wider team.

Required

What you’ll need to succeed:

Undergraduate degree required (business or technology preferred).
Practical experience (5–10+ years) in one or more of: IT Cost Benchmarking, IT Financial Management, or Project Management.
Experience in project-driven environments.
Presentation and facilitation experience demonstrated through prior client-facing engagements.
Eligibility to obtain appropriate work authorization for cross-border engagements within North America.
Availability for periodic after-hours work to support APAC-based client engagements.

Strongly Preferred

History of gaining and maintaining trusted-advisor status with management; strong working relationships with the C-suite.
Experience leading teams, given the advisory nature of the services offered (this is not a formal people-management role).
Professional certifications in Finance and Accounting, Project Management, Business Analysis, or other related disciplines.
Active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analytical, research, or writing workflows.

Assets

MA, MBA, or MSc.
Experience with ERP or financial systems as cost data sources (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Dynamics, etc.).
Prior experience contributing to cross-departmental initiatives (e.g., Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, Global Services).

Visa Requirement:
Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements:
Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service APAC clients.

Language Skills:
Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Skills & Attributes

Client Interaction & Facilitation - Leads calls and benchmark engagements with C-suite Members; facilitates discussion and builds trusted-advisor standing.
Benchmarking & Cost Analysis - Deep working knowledge of IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking methodology, cost frameworks, and peer set construction.
Project Management - Manages engagement timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across concurrent client benchmarks.
Business Development - Identifies and helps develop opportunities to grow the benchmarking service and its value to clients.
Executive Writing & Presentation - Produces and delivers polished, executive-ready written analysis, decks, and keynote presentations.
AI Productivity Tooling - Practical use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, research, and writing. A working habit, not a credential.

new_jobs.title: Director, Cloud Governance
new_jobs.description:
Scopely
is seeking a Director, Cloud Governance
to lead efforts in establishing and enforcing standards, policies, and guardrails across Scopely’s multi-cloud environment. This is a remote opportunity for individuals in Canada or the United States.

As a Director, Cloud Governance
you will play a pivotal leadership role in defining and executing the Scopely’s Cloud Governance strategy. This team will define, implement, and enforce the policies and controls that govern how cloud infrastructure is used across a decentralized organization of game, platform, and product teams.

This role is critical to bringing structure, consistency, and guardrails to Scopely’s cloud footprint, and will be key in modernizing our overall governance posture. As a central leader, you will drive alignment across highly autonomous teams and translate governance into practical, adoptable solutions while balancing control and development velocity.

This is a foundational leadership role; you will establish governance from the ground up, introduce scalable and enforceable controls, and drive adoption and buy-in across various teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders.

What You Will Do

Build & Lead Cloud Governance

Build and lead a Cloud Governance team
Define the operating model for how governance partners with game teams, security, and FinOps
Establish clear ownership and enforcement mechanisms for cloud policies

Define & Enforce Cloud Guardrails

Design and implement enforceable controls across AWS and GCP, including:
AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies (SCPs)
GCP Organization Policies and IAM constraints

Establish guardrails around:
Resource provisioning and service usage
Region restrictions and data residency
Identity and access management
Network architecture and environment isolation

Own the mandate to enforce policies, including the ability to restrict or block non-compliant usage

Standardize Cloud Structure

Define and implement standards for:
AWS account structure and GCP project/folder hierarchy
Environment segmentation (prod, staging, dev)
Naming conventions and resource organization

Bring consistency across a fragmented, multi-team cloud footprint

Tagging & Governance

Define and enforce tagging standards in partnership with FinOps
Ensure all resources are attributable (ownership, environment, cost center)
Enable downstream cost allocation and operational visibility

Stakeholder Partnership

Collaborate with FinOps on cost allocation and optimization levers (budgets, quotas, usage controls)
Partner with Security to align governance with security and compliance requirements
Work directly with game teams to safely roll out and drive adoption of policies and standards

AI-Forward Governance & Automation

Define and execute an AI-native vision for cloud governance, transforming the function into an intelligent, policy-driven operating model powered by autonomous and agentic systems
Establish the organization’s strategy for governance autonomy, defining where fully autonomous operations, human-on-the-loop oversight, and human-in-the-loop approvals are appropriate based on risk, business impact, and compliance requirements
Architect and drive agentic governance capabilities that continuously monitor cloud environments, detect risk, and autonomously remediate anomalies at scale
Partner across engineering, data, and security, and platform teams to embed responsible AI governance into cloud platforms, establishing guardrails for AI adoption, autonomous decision-making, and auditability

What We're Looking For

10+ years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE
3–5+ years leading teams in complex, multi-team environments
Experience operating in decentralized or federated engineering organizations
Proven track record implementing cloud governance and enforcement at scale
Experience managing or influencing environments with $50M+ cloud spend
Deep hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
Experience with policy-as-code and governance tooling (e.g., OPA, Sentinel, AWS Config)
Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and multi-account design

In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range

$175,000—$210,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Barbecues Galore is a specialty retailer with eight store locations and a growing e-commerce business. We help customers explore barbecues, outdoor kitchens, patio furniture, fireplaces, accessories and related products through knowledgeable in-store service and convenient online shopping.

We are looking for a Director of Marketing & Digital Commerce to lead our entire marketing and e-commerce operations. You will own the website and digital content, build our brand, bring more customers into our showrooms and grow profitable online revenue. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can turn strategy into measurable retail and digital sales results.

·  Retail traffic and sales: Create local and company-wide campaigns that increase qualified visits and sales at all eight stores; lead local SEO, Google Business Profiles, geo-targeted advertising, signage and store-specific promotions.
·  E-commerce growth: Own online sales strategy, revenue targets, merchandising, customer acquisition, conversion, checkout improvements, average order value, retention and profitability.
·  One connected customer journey: Make the website a powerful research and store-visit tool as well as a high-performing online shop; connect promotions, product information and customer experiences across channels.

·  Marketing and brand: Lead brand positioning, seasonal campaigns, paid search and social, SEO, email, social content, creative production, product launches and customer loyalty initiatives.
·  In-store cooking demos and vendor events: Plan and schedule demonstrations across stores, delivered by our own teams and vendor representatives; coordinate products, staffing, logistics and promotion to generate attendance, engagement and sales.
·  Team and partner leadership: Lead and develop marketing and e-commerce employees; manage agencies, developers, vendors, projects and collaboration with store management, Purchasing, Operations and IT.
·  Budgets, systems and results: Manage marketing budgets and digital tools; coordinate with IT on e-commerce, CRM, inventory and POS integrations; track performance and improve marketing return on investment.

How success will be measured

Growth in store traffic and retail sales; profitable online revenue; website conversion and average order value; customer acquisition and retention; local search visibility; successful in-store events; campaign return on investment; and strong team execution.

Qualifications & Experience

Required
Significant leadership experience in marketing, digital commerce, and retail-related business operations.
Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies that drive both physical store traffic and online sales.
Strong understanding of omnichannel retail marketing and customer purchasing behavior.
Experience managing e-commerce platforms and delivering measurable online revenue growth.
Proven ability to lead marketing teams, manage budgets, and oversee external agencies.
Experience with website management, digital content, SEO, paid advertising, and analytics.
Strong knowledge of digital customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies.

Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and project management skills.

Preferred

Experience with large online product catalogues and complex product information.
Familiarity with retail point-of-sale, inventory, CRM, ERP, and e-commerce integrations.
Experience developing local store marketing programs alongside national or company-wide campaigns.
Experience managing seasonal retail promotional calendars.
Demonstrated success leading website improvements and digital transformation projects.

new_jobs.title: Research Director, IT Financial Management
new_jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The ITFM (IT Financial Management) practice helps IT leaders around the world answer a hard question with evidence: how does our technology spend compared to our peers, and where should we improve? As Research Director, you own the delivery of Infotech's flagship IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking service - the engagements that put that evidence in front of CIOs and CFOs.

You will provide experience-based benchmarking insight and guidance that helps IT leaders drive measurable results, maintaining an active pulse on the needs of Members located globally and staying current on industry developments so you can deliver exceptional service across calls and benchmark engagements - in collaboration with analysts, Research Directors, and colleagues across the Research Division.

This is a senior, client-facing advisory role. While it is not a formal people-management position, you set the standard the wider ITFM analyst team works to, and your judgment shapes how the benchmarking service itself evolves.

Our promise to you

You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback, and building strong relationships.

What You Will Do, Includes, But Not Limited To

Lead ITFM Benchmarking engagements

Lead and deliver ITFM’s flagship offering - IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking engagements with analyst support.
Act as a trusted guide for C-suite clients in IT Financial Management, sharing insight on how to manage costs better and lessons from their industry on improving IT’s cost-to-value through benchmarking.
Improve the benchmarking service through your expertise — new ways of representing data and new opportunities to enhance the insights delivered.
Keep a pulse on industry trends and best practices in your areas of expertise, contributing ideas that shape the benchmarking service.

Cross Departmental Collaboration & Support

Support Call Advisory, Workshops, and Global Services teams by advising peers on IT Spend and Staff Benchmark research and analysis as needed.
Provide subject-matter expertise and feedback to other Research Division teams and to partnering divisions — Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, and others — as needed.
Design and build high-quality keynote and other presentations and deliver them successfully as needed.

Practice & Analyst Development

Contribute to and help with own benchmarking methodology, mapping standards, and delivery toolsets, working with Research Directors and the Practice Lead.
Support automation and data infrastructure initiatives that improve engagement consistency and scalability.
Mentor Research Analysts, reviewing their benchmark outputs and client-ready materials and helping them progress toward independent engagement leadership.
Make active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analysis, research, and writing workflows, and help bring effective practices to the wider team.

Required

What you’ll need to succeed:

Undergraduate degree required (business or technology preferred).
Practical experience (5–10+ years) in one or more of: IT Cost Benchmarking, IT Financial Management, or Project Management.
Experience in project-driven environments.
Presentation and facilitation experience demonstrated through prior client-facing engagements.
Eligibility to obtain appropriate work authorization for cross-border engagements within North America.
Availability for periodic after-hours work to support APAC-based client engagements.

Strongly Preferred

History of gaining and maintaining trusted-advisor status with management; strong working relationships with the C-suite.
Experience leading teams, given the advisory nature of the services offered (this is not a formal people-management role).
Professional certifications in Finance and Accounting, Project Management, Business Analysis, or other related disciplines.
Active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analytical, research, or writing workflows.

Assets

MA, MBA, or MSc.
Experience with ERP or financial systems as cost data sources (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Dynamics, etc.).
Prior experience contributing to cross-departmental initiatives (e.g., Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, Global Services).

Visa Requirement:
Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements:
Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service APAC clients.

Language Skills:
Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Skills & Attributes

Client Interaction & Facilitation - Leads calls and benchmark engagements with C-suite Members; facilitates discussion and builds trusted-advisor standing.
Benchmarking & Cost Analysis - Deep working knowledge of IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking methodology, cost frameworks, and peer set construction.
Project Management - Manages engagement timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across concurrent client benchmarks.
Business Development - Identifies and helps develop opportunities to grow the benchmarking service and its value to clients.
Executive Writing & Presentation - Produces and delivers polished, executive-ready written analysis, decks, and keynote presentations.
AI Productivity Tooling - Practical use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, research, and writing. A working habit, not a credential.
Inclusion - Works effectively and respectfully with a globally distributed team and Member base.
Knowledge Application & Decision Making - Applies sound problem-solving and judgment in ambiguous, data-light situations.
Managing Through Change & Uncertainty - Stays effective and credible as client needs, data, and priorities shift.
Dynamic Learning Mindset - Keeps a pulse on industry trends and brings new thinking back into the practice.
Mentorship & Collaboration - Reviews and improves analyst work and shares knowledge proactively across the team.
